set.seed(1234)

counts <- readMM("matrix.mtx")
barcodes <- read.delim("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.delim("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

rownames(counts) <- make.unique(genes[[2]])
colnames(counts) <- barcodes[[1]]

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

pbmc <- subset(
  pbmc,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5
)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

  ggtitle("PBMC clusters on UMAP")

library(BiocParallel)

matrix_file <- "path/to/matrix.mtx.gz"
features_file <- "path/to/features.tsv.gz"
barcodes_file <- "path/to/barcodes.tsv.gz"

read_10x_mtx <- function(matrix_file, features_file, barcodes_file) {
  counts <- if (grepl("\\.gz$", matrix_file)) {
    Matrix::readMM(gzfile(matrix_file))
  } else {
    Matrix::readMM(matrix_file)
  }
  
  features <- read.delim(
    features_file,
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  barcodes <- read.delim(
    barcodes_file,
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  gene_names <- if (ncol(features) >= 2) features[[2]] else features[[1]]
  gene_names <- make.unique(gene_names)
  
  rownames(counts) <- gene_names
  colnames(counts) <- barcodes[[1]]
  
  counts
}

    file.exists(file.path(x, "features.tsv")) ||

if (length(sample_paths) < 3) {
  # Fallback: try to infer 3 files/directories from the working directory
  sample_paths <- entries[grepl("matrix|filtered_feature_bc_matrix|raw_feature_bc_matrix|10x|pbmc", basename(entries), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  sample_paths <- unique(dirname(sample_paths))
  sample_paths <- sample_paths[dir.exists(sample_paths) & vapply(sample_paths, is_10x_dir, logical(1))]

read_counts <- function(path) {
  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    obj <- Read10X(data.dir = path)
    if (is.list(obj)) {
      if ("Gene Expression" %in% names(obj)) obj <- obj[["Gene Expression"]] else obj <- obj[[1]]
    }
    return(obj)
  }
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  if (ext %in% c("rds", "rda", "rdata")) {
    if (ext == "rds") return(readRDS(path))
    e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    load(path, envir = e)
    objs <- ls(e)
    if (length(objs) == 1) return(get(objs, envir = e))
    stop("RData/RDA must contain exactly one object.")
  }
  if (ext %in% c("mtx", "gz")) {
    stop("For Matrix Market input, provide a directory containing matrix.mtx(.gz), features.tsv(.gz), and barcodes.tsv(.gz).")
  }
  stop("Unsupported input path. Provide a 10X directory or an RDS/RData object containing counts.")
}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

counts <- readMM("matrix.mtx")
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1
rownames(counts) <- make.unique(genes$V2)

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, npcs = 30)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

sweep.res <- paramSweep(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
optimal.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(pbmc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

pbmc <- doubletFinder(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = optimal.pk,
                      nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

df.col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = df.col) +
  ggtitle("Singlets vs Doublets")

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

  colMeans(cluster_avg[intersect(g, rownames(cluster_avg)), , drop = FALSE])
})

cluster_assignments <- colnames(score_matrix)[apply(score_matrix, 1, which.max)]

names(new_ids) <- levels(pbmc)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, new_ids)

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "cell_type") +
  ggtitle("Annotated PBMC UMAP")

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.(h5|csv|tsv|txt|rds)$", full.names = TRUE)

read_counts <- function(f) {
  ext <- tools::file_ext(f)
  if (ext == "h5") {
    Read10X_h5(f)
  } else if (ext == "rds") {
    readRDS(f)
  } else if (ext %in% c("csv")) {
    as.matrix(read.csv(f, row.names = 1))
  } else {
    as.matrix(read.table(f, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t"))
  }
}

sample_names <- c("PBMC1", "PBMC2", "PBMC3")

seurat_list <- lapply(seq_along(files), function(i) {
  counts <- read_counts(files[i])
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = sample_names[i], min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  obj$sample <- sample_names[i]
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")

)

      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Up in cluster 2",
